name: Every Guitar Chord You Need to Know
instructions: Expand beyond your first two chords toward a fuller set of open chords (C, G, A, E, Em, Am, D) used in the vast majority of beginner songs.
Learn one new chord shape today and drill it in isolation before combining it with others.
Build a simple reference chart (chord name + finger positions) to check yourself against as you learn each new shape.
Watch today's video for a full rundown of the essential chord vocabulary.
